pitUniverse.evidence: every row's membership snapshot is strictly older than its signal date

filingVisibility.evidence: every filing-based cell's visibility date (receipt date + 1) is before its signal date

macroReleaseTiming.evidence: the only macro input is the BOK base rate, applied from its announcement date (test_bok_rate_is_the_latest_announced_rate); no revised macro panel is used. Coverage limit: no vintage-safe Korean macro series exists in the repository.

labelMaturityAndPurge.evidence: each fold's latest training-label exit session precedes its first test signal date; every exit is 126 KR sessions after the session following the signal

leakCanaryPermutedTrainingLabels.firstRunNote: a first single-draw version of this check read FAIL (permuted ICs 0.006 / -0.120 / -0.200 in 2019/2021/2023); one draw of a noise-trained model is a random factor tilt and cannot separate leakage from factor variance, so the check was rerun with 10 draws per year
leakCanaryPermutedTrainingLabels.evidence: PASS means noise-trained models average ~0 OOS IC: the features do not carry the label. The p-value compares the real model's mean IC with the distribution of noise-trained models' mean IC.

normalisationAndImputation.evidence: company/industry features are within-date percentile ranks (same-date only); linear market z-scores and tree market medians are fitted on the training fold only (tournament._linear_matrix / _tree_matrix); no feature selection step exists - feature sets are fixed in config.json

dividendsSplitsCorporateActions.evidence: stock returns are replay-v16 total-return closes: split-continuous, Yahoo distributions forward-accumulated. Continuing-name dividend completeness is corroborated on 25 names only (99.1% of DART dividend-years matched, v2.31); the 22 terminated names carry no distributions at all. The ETF uses the independently reconciled series. Codex's DPS correction (#328, 241560) concerns the shareholder-event input, not this price panel.

terminalConsiderationAndSuspension.evidence: no terminal consideration is sealed; a held terminating name is written off (primary, lower bound) or converted at its last close (sensitivity, upper bound); a suspended name cannot be traded (tested). The gap between the two bounds is published per strategy as cagrUpperBoundTerminalAtLastClose.

selectionVersusEvaluation.evidence: each model's hyperparameters are fixed by config, so there is no inner tuning; but the tournament ranking itself is computed on the same 2016-2026 window it reports. That selection bias is measured, not removed: nested past-only selection, deflated Sharpe, CSCV PBO (overfit-diagnostics-*.json).
